description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants listed in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. The “Vanilla” curve (purple, solid line) drops steeply from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to roughly 2.7 by around 10,000 iterations, then gradually decreases to about 2.48 by 140,000. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” curve (light blue/cyan, solid line) similarly falls quickly from about 3.4 at the start to around 2.85 near 10,000, then declines more slowly to approximately 2.61 at 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=64)” curve (orange, solid line) decreases from about 3.4 initially to roughly 2.75 around 10,000, then continues downward to about 2.52 by 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” curve (green, solid line) starts near 3.4, drops to around 2.74 by about 10,000, and then gradually declines to roughly 2.51 at 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” curve (red, solid line) falls from about 3.4 at the beginning to around 2.72 near 10,000 and then trends downward to about 2.49 by 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=128)” curve (dark blue, solid line) begins near 3.4, drops to approximately 2.71 around 10,000, and then steadily decreases to about 2.50 at 140,000.
